text: The historical collector replaces a truthy flags check with childFlags.Get(name, &flags), so an existing zero value can be passed to UpdateFlags. A scoped manual recommendation is to distinguish missing metadata from a valid zero bitfield when importing cached folder state. The original collector is retired; its empty-name fallback and current replacement were not proved equivalent for every cache entry. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Test map presence separately from a zero flag value
